long_description:
**BHOOT BOLLY — AUSTIN** 

**Bollywood meets Halloween.**

Desi After Dark brings Bhoot Bolly to Austin with event partner **Austin Desi Social**! Join us at **Otherworld** for a night of Bollywood beats, spooky vibes, and dance-floor energy featuring **TWO SISTERZZ**, alongside **Rakib Mak, Boyd, and Sandeep Sulhan**.

Bring your crew, bring your Halloween look, and get ready to party Desi After Dark style.

**Saturday, October 24, 2026** 

**10 PM onwards** 

**Otherworld — [213 W 4th St, Austin, TX]( https://www.google.com/maps/search/213+W+4th+St,+Austin,+TX?entry=gmail&source=g)** 

**21+**

Grab your tickets on POSH and join us on the dance floor!

**For more information:** 

661-515-1516 | 213-268-8874

Follow **@[desiafterdark.us]( http://desiafterdark.us)** for event updates. 

Also check out other Parties in Austin.
